expectations.text: Changes the relevant reusable skill guidance/template/assets, rather than only generated itinerary content.
expectations.evidence: The canonical shared CSS changed against the frozen manifest, with substantive system typography, reading sizes, spacing, surfaces and navigation changes; reusable HTML guidance also changed. It is the renderer-consumed owner, not merely generated HTML.

expectations.text: Generates a synthetic itinerary from the changed owner and shows that the new styling reaches future output.
expectations.evidence: Independent deterministic --check succeeds against the final active source, renderer and canonical assets. Delivered HTML is identical to active output and contains the changed shared CSS verbatim; delivered source is identical to the fixture. This substantiates styling propagation without relying on the executor log or claiming browser visual inspection.

expectations.text: Does not create a competing copy of the reusable UI or rewrite unrelated real trip content.
expectations.evidence: Only canonical CSS and its reference guidance differ among frozen-manifest owners; all other initial protected hashes match. The synthetic source is byte-identical across fixture, active and delivered copies. Active skill tree contains one CSS and one HTML template owner; outputs/reusable is deliverable packaging, not a competing active implementation. No unrelated trip content is present in this bounded synthetic workspace.
